author: Karen Jones
text:
January 2024.   Doug White and Keith Driver took care of my problem right away.  I met them earlier in the year with another issues and they were just as professional and personable this time. I couldn’t ask for better service and so quick to respond after my call!  I was so pleased with the timing, the service, and the repair. Highly recommend!

Update 12/20/24.  De’Jhon Bryant did an awesome job today with the follow up root killer treatment. .  Fast, friendly, courteous, professional all the way! Very pleased and highly recommend!

author: BreeAnn Page
text: We had a late night emergency causing flooding in our bathrooms. But we called their 24hr number and Keith showed up within an hour and had it fixed within 20 min. He worked fast and efficiently. Great service, we will definitely use them again.

author: Fred Mayo
text: Jesse did some hard work snaking a stubborn drain. He kept at it until the job was done. I was very impressed with his work ethic and respect for our home through what turned out to be a messy ordeal. Very congenial, polite and courteous. Highly recommend.

author: Kimberly Coghlan
text: We had an emergency leak late at night, and the technician, Keith, called us and told us what to do until he could get there. He arrived early the next morning and was efficient and courteous. Pricing was also fair. We're very pleased. Keith is amazing!

author: Andy O'Reilly
text: Timothy Wright, the Technician who did the work, is outstanding! I was extremely pleased with the quality and timeliness of the work. Tim was very professional and friendly, and he explained all aspects of the problem before, during, and after the work. The Roto Rooter scheduling staff were very helpful and professional as well.
